1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# run-ablation.sh — the cycle-130 ablation batch runner (SDD §5.9, §3.4; sprint Task 3.2;
     4	# DEC-0405, DEC-0407, DEC-0413, DEC-0417, DEC-0418, DEC-0428, DEC-0429, DEC-0435, DEC-0545,
     5	# DEC-0553, DEC-0554)
     6	#
     7	# Plans a batch (arm × applicable task × trial), dispatches every trial to
     8	# pipeline-run.sh against a pinned source tree, checks after each trial that the arm
     9	# took effect and that the CLI version and model ids did not drift, grades the run,
    10	# writes its runs.jsonl row, and keeps MANIFEST.json and STATUS.json for the batch.
    11	#
    12	# Usage:
    13	#   run-ablation.sh --arms CSV --source-commit SHA [--tasks CSV] [--types CSV]
    14	#                   [--trials-build N] [--trials-review N] [--max-usd USD] [--run-cap USD]
    15	#                   [--concurrency 3] [--batch NAME] [--results-root DIR] [--rows F]
    16	#                   [--suite-root DIR] [--suite-file F] [--image IMG] [--executor container|host]
    17	#                   [--pre-registration-ref TEXT] [--seed N] [--self-check-log F]
    18	#                   [--smoke] [--dry-run] [--resume] [--detach] [--clear-arm ID]...
    19	#                   [--clear-drift] [--rerow RUN_ID]... [--rerun RUN_ID]... [--rerun-status S]...
    20	#                   [--pipeline-bin P] [--grade-bin G] [--row-bin R] [--took-effect-bin T]
    21	#                   [--docker-bin D]
    22	#
    23	# Options:
    24	#   --arms CSV           arm ids in the order given (default: the suite's priority minus
    25	#                        every arm declared absent: true); each must be declared
    26	#   --source-commit SHA  the Loa commit the arms run (the pinned source tree)
    27	#   --tasks CSV          task ids (default: every <suite-root>/tasks/<id>/task.yaml;
    28	#                        --smoke: every smoke/<id>/)
    29	#   --types CSV          keep tasks of these types (feature-build, bug-fix, refactor,
    30	#                        review-catch; `build` = the three build types)
    31	#   --trials-build N     trials per build task (default the suite's trials.build; --smoke 1)
    32	#   --trials-review N    trials per review-catch task (default trials.review-catch; --smoke 1)
    33	#   --max-usd USD        batch spend cap (see Spend); no cap when absent
    34	#   --run-cap USD        per-run cap passed to pipeline-run.sh --max-run-usd and reserved per
    35	#                        running trial (default evals.ablation.run_cap_usd in .loa.config.yaml,
    36	#                        else the suite's caps.run_usd, else 12)
    37	#   --concurrency N      trials at once, 1-9 (default 3)
    38	#   --batch NAME         batch directory name (default batch-<UTC ts>; --smoke smoke-<UTC ts>;
    39	#                        the smoke- prefix is reserved for --smoke)
    40	#   --results-root DIR   where batch directories live (default
    41	#                        grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/batches; --smoke
    42	#                        evals/results/ablation-2.0)
    43	#   --rows F             the rows file (default: --smoke <batch>/rows.jsonl; otherwise
    44	#                        grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl, the tracked file, or
    45	#                        <results-root>/runs.jsonl when --results-root is given). A smoke
    46	#                        batch never writes the tracked file (DEC-0428: smoke rows decide nothing)
    47	#   --suite-root DIR     suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0)
    48	#   --suite-file F       suite file (default evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml)
    49	#   --image IMG          container image (default loa-ablation:258)
    50	#   --executor MODE      container (default) or host; passed to pipeline-run.sh and the grader
    51	#                        (host grading needs LOA_EVAL_ALLOW_HOST_GRADING=1, see ablation-grade.sh)
    52	#   --pre-registration-ref TEXT  the NOTES pre-registration heading and timestamp (MANIFEST)
    53	#   --seed N             shuffle seed (default 20261015)
    54	#   --self-check-log F   the recorded image self-check (default
    55	#                        grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-259/self-check-image.log)
    56	#   --smoke              smoke batch: smoke/ tasks, one trial each, no hard gate, own rows
    57	#   --dry-run            run the pre-flight, print the plan, write MANIFEST.json only
    58	#                        (MANIFEST.dry-run.json when the batch already has a STATUS.json)
    59	#   --resume             continue --batch NAME from its MANIFEST.json, STATUS.json and rows
    60	#   --detach             re-exec under setsid nohup (log <batch>/driver.log), print the batch
    61	#                        directory and the pid, exit 0
    62	#   --clear-arm ID       with --resume: remove ID from STATUS.json paused_arms (repeatable)
    63	#   --clear-drift        with --resume: re-read the run named by STATUS.json drift (its run dir
    64	#                        <batch>/<arm>/<task>-t<n>, or the highest -r<k> sibling) with the
    65	#                        current drift guard; none → drift null, an entry in drift_cleared[] and
    66	#                        the batch continues; still a drift → exit 2 printing it, nothing written
    67	#   --rerow RUN_ID       with --resume: run the post-run chain (took-effect, drift guard, grade,
    68	#                        ablation-row.sh with the old row's attempts and retry_reason) again
    69	#                        over the run dir of RUN_ID and replace its one row in place, under the
    70	#                        rows file's flock (temp file beside it, --validate, mv); repeatable;
    71	#                        before reconciliation, so spend and per_arm count the new row once.
    72	#                        Refused (exit 2, nothing written) when RUN_ID is not <batch>-… or not
    73	#                        in the plan, has no row or more than one, has no run dir, or its row
    74	#                        is interrupted or transport_error (those trials are reruns)
    75	#   --rerun RUN_ID       with --resume (DEC-0553): launch RUN_ID again, at its plan index, into a
    76	#                        fresh -r<k> run dir; when its new row lands it replaces the old row in
    77	#                        place (replace_row, under the flock) and STATUS.json rerun[] gets
    78	#                        {run_id, from, to, old_cost_usd, at}. The row must be transport_error,
    79	#                        interrupted or infrastructure_error, else exit 2 with nothing written
    80	#                        (also: not <batch>-…, not in the plan, no row or more than one, or the
    81	#                        same id also given to --rerow); repeatable
    82	#   --rerun-status S     with --resume: rerun every row of the batch whose status is S, one of
    83	#                        transport_error, interrupted, infrastructure_error (anything else is a
    84	#                        usage error); read after the rerows, and a --rerow id is never rerun;
    85	#                        repeatable. A flagged row leaves the done set: no counter and no
    86	#                        assumed charge, only its reported cost stays in spent (it moves to
    87	#                        ledger_usd when the replacement lands); the in-flight reservation
    88	#                        covers the new trial and its row is accounted once when it lands
    89	#   --pipeline-bin P, --grade-bin G, --row-bin R, --took-effect-bin T, --docker-bin D
    90	#                        the five collaborators (defaults: the scripts beside this one, and
    91	#                        $EVAL_DOCKER_BIN else docker)
    92	#
    93	# Pre-flight (any refusal: exit 2, nothing written but <batch>/REFUSED.txt with the reason):
    94	#   1. hard gate, non-smoke batches only (DEC-0435): <suite-root>/MANIFEST.sha256 present,
    95	#      the self-check log present with at least 2 × tasks + review-catch tasks lines
    96	#      `…: PASS` (36 for the sixteen-task suite) and no `: FAIL` line, a REVIEW.md in every
    97	#      <suite-root>/tasks/<id>/; their sha256 go to MANIFEST.json gate
    98	#   2. freeze.sh --check --root <suite-root> --suite-file <suite-file> (it runs
    99	#      validate-suite.sh), with --smoke when MANIFEST.sha256 lists a smoke/ path or the batch
   100	#      is a smoke batch (the manifest is checked as it was frozen)
   101	#   3. seed-corpus-from-record.sh --check (the review-catch corpus SHA256SUMS)
   102	#   4. container: the docker CLI and the image (`docker image inspect`)
   103	#   5. the pinned source tree: $LOA_ABLATION_SOURCE_TREE when set (tests; must be a git tree
   104	#      at the commit, with .claude/), else a detached worktree
   105	#      $LOA_ABLATION_CACHE/ablation-src-<sha12> (default ~/.cache/loa) cut from
   106	#      $LOA_ABLATION_SOURCE_REPO (default this repository) with git worktree add --detach;
   107	#      it must be at the commit and pristine (git status --porcelain --ignored empty)
   108	#   --resume also refuses when the source commit, the suite manifest hash, the image digest
   109	#   or the CLI version differ from MANIFEST.json, or when STATUS.json records a drift
   110	#   (unless --clear-drift re-reads that run clean under the current rule).
   111	#
   112	# Plan: arms × tasks × trials. An arm whose task_types excludes a task's type is dropped for
   113	# that task with one `refused:` line and never dispatched (DEC-0405). The order is
   114	# trial-major (every arm × task once before any second trial); inside each trial block the
   115	# entries (arm-major, tasks by id) are shuffled with one python3 random.Random(<seed>)
   116	# generator, blocks in trial order (Fisher-Yates via random.shuffle: reproducible for a seed
   117	# across CPython 3.x). run_id = <batch>-<arm>-<task>-t<n>; run dir <batch>/<arm>/<task>-t<n>,
   118	# a fresh <…>-r<k> (k ≥ 2) for a transport retry or a resumed rerun (the run_id stays).
   119	# --dry-run prints `plan: …`, the `refused:` lines and one line per trial
   120	# `<arm> <task> <type> <trial> <run_id>`.
   121	#
   122	# Per trial, in order: pipeline-run.sh --task-yaml … --arm … --run-dir … --run-id … --trial …
   123	#   --source-tree <pinned> --suite-file … --executor … --image … --docker-bin …
   124	#   --max-run-usd <run-cap>, output to <batch>/<arm>/<task>-t<n>.log; then
   125	#   1. status from meta/pipeline.json (missing or `running` → interrupted; a missing record
   126	#      is written as a minimal pipeline.json with synthesized_by: run-ablation.sh)
   127	#   2. transport: agent_error plus a provider signature in the failing phase's
   128	#      stderr-<label>.log or events-<label>.jsonl (lib/arms-common.sh
   129	#      is_pipeline_transport_failure) is retried ONCE after $LOA_ABLATION_RETRY_WAIT_S
   130	#      (default 120) into a fresh run dir: attempts 2, retry_reason; the first attempt writes
   131	#      no row and its spent_usd counts in spend; a second transport failure is rowed
   132	#      transport_error. agent_error without the signature is never retried (DEC-0417)
   133	#   3. took-effect.sh --run-dir D --suite-file F (completed, agent_error and cap_failure runs):
   134	#      a FAIL rows the trial infrastructure_error and pauses the arm (STATUS.json
   135	#      paused_arms; no further trial of it launches until --resume --clear-arm ID) (DEC-0418)
   136	#   4. drift guard (DEC-0407 as amended by DEC-0545): a phase drifts on model grounds only
   137	#      when its model_requested differs from MANIFEST phase_models[name], or when the
   138	#      requested model (else the manifest's) is absent from a non-empty models_used (ids
   139	#      normalised as ablation-row.sh does: no Bedrock region prefix, no -vN:M suffix). Any
   140	#      other models_used key is an extra model, telemetry and not drift (Claude Code's
   141	#      WebFetch summariser or a built-in subagent): one `run-ablation: extra model <id> in
   142	#      <labels> (<N> output tokens; …)` line in the trial log, the trial result's
   143	#      extra_models and STATUS.json extra_models. The transcripts' system/init
   144	#      claude_code_version (or version) equals MANIFEST cli_version (when neither carries a
   145	#      version, pipeline.json image_digest must equal MANIFEST image_digest). A mismatch rows
   146	#      the trial infrastructure_error, records STATUS.json drift, launches nothing more and
   147	#      fails the batch once the running trials end
   148	#   5. ablation-grade.sh D <task> --suite-root … [--tasks-dir smoke] --executor … --image …
   149	#      --docker-bin … (scored runs that passed 3 and 4; exit 2 → row infrastructure_error)
   150	#   6. ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F --manifest <batch>/MANIFEST.json
   151	#      --attempts N [--retry-reason R] [--status S] --out <job row>; the runner appends the
   152	#      row to the rows file under flock and runs ablation-row.sh --validate on it
   153	#      (--allow-ungraded for smoke) and refuses a run_id rowed twice (state failed)
   154	#   Watchdog (DEC-0429): a trial whose pipeline has no final meta/pipeline.json status after
   155	#   twice its phase-sum timeout (the planned phases' timeout_min: task bounds, else the
   156	#   suite's phase_defaults, BARE = PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 × FIX) gets SIGTERM to its process
   157	#   group, SIGKILL after $LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_GRACE_S (default 60), and is rowed
   158	#   interrupted. $LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_S replaces the deadline (seconds; tests).
   159	#   Outage breaker (DEC-0554): $LOA_ABLATION_OUTAGE_BREAKER (default 3; 0 disables) consecutive
   160	#   collected trials rowed transport_error (collection order, any arm; any other collected
   161	#   trial resets the count) stop further launches; the running trials end, STATUS.json outage
   162	#   is set and the batch finishes partial (exit 1): `partial (outage breaker): N consecutive
   163	#   transport failures; --resume --rerun-status transport_error after the network is back`.
   164	#
   165	# Spend (--max-usd, SDD §5.5 reused through lib/arms-common.sh): before each launch,
   166	#   spent + in_flight × run_cap + est_next > max waits for a running trial and
   167	#   spent + est_next > max cuts (no further launches; STATUS.json cuts[] gets {reason,
   168	#   spent, in_flight_reserved, max, est_next, trials_launched, at_trial}; exit 1).
   169	#   est_next = the mean cost of this arm's completed trials of the task kind (build |
   170	#   review-catch), else the kind's pooled mean, else the suite's cost_hint[kind]. spent =
   171	#   rows' cost_usd + transport first attempts' spent_usd + assumed charges: a trial ending
   172	#   neither completed nor with a reported cost is charged run_cap, a cap_failure is charged
   173	#   max(cost, run_cap); both count in spend.assumed_cap_trials when the charge exceeds the
   174	#   reported cost.
   175	#
   176	# Files: <results-root>/<batch>/{MANIFEST.json, STATUS.json, run.log, spend.txt,
   177	#   REFUSED.txt, driver.log, .gitignore (non-smoke: the run directories and logs stay out of
   178	#   git), <arm>/<task>-t<n>[-r<k>]/ (pipeline-run.sh run dirs), <arm>/<task>-t<n>.log};
   179	#   rows to the rows file. MANIFEST.json (§3.4): schema_version, suite, batch, dry_run,
   180	#   smoke, created, source_commit, source_worktree, source_commit_dot_claude_delta (git diff
   181	#   --stat 4d69c3c4..<commit> -- .claude/, ≤ 4,000 chars), harness_commit, harness_dirty,
   182	#   suite_file, suite_root, tasks_dir, rows_file, suite_version, suite_manifest_sha256, arms,
   183	#   tasks, refused, trials_per_type, trials_planned, plan, arm_map, shuffle_seed, shuffle,
   184	#   fingerprint, image, image_digest, executor_mode, cli_version (`docker run --rm --network
   185	#   none <image> claude --version`, host: the CLI's), cli_version_raw, tools, phase_models,
   186	#   caps {cycle_usd, run_usd, reserve_usd, max_usd}, cost_hint, concurrency, retry,
   187	#   watchdog, pre_registration_ref, gate (null for smoke), corpus, agy_opt_in, environment.
   188	#   STATUS.json (§3.4), rewritten after every trial: {schema_version, suite, batch, smoke,
   189	#   state: running|complete|partial|failed, per_arm: {<arm>: {trials_planned, launched,
   190	#   completed, failed (agent_error), excluded (transport_error, infrastructure_error,
   191	#   interrupted, contaminated), cap_failures, degraded, skipped_paused}}, retries: [{run_id,
   192	#   reason, first_attempt_usd}], cuts: [...], paused_arms: {<arm>: reason}, spend: {rows_usd,
   193	#   ledger_usd (transport first attempts, and the reported cost of rows a rerun replaced), spent_usd, max_usd, assumed_cap_trials}, resume_cursor (the
   194	#   index of the first plan entry without a row), drift: null | {run_id, field, expected,
   195	#   got}, drift_cleared: [{run_id, previous, cleared_at, harness_commit}] (--clear-drift),
   196	#   rerowed: [{run_id, from, to, at}] (--rerow), rerun: [{run_id, from, to, old_cost_usd, at}]
   197	#   (--rerun, --rerun-status), rerun_pending: [run_id…] (flagged, no replacement yet), outage:
   198	#   null | {at, consecutive, last_run_id, message} (the breaker), outage_history: [the
   199	#   outages a later --resume cleared], extra_models: {<raw id>: {runs,
   200	#   output_tokens}} ({} when none; derived from extra_models_by_run: {<run_id>: {<raw id>:
   201	#   output_tokens}}, the per-run source a rerow replaces), rows_invalid, started,
   202	#   finished}. At the end the spend.sh line and a batch line go to <batch>/spend.txt.
   203	#
   204	# --resume: reads MANIFEST.json (plan, arms, suite paths, executor, image, run cap, rows
   205	#   file) and STATUS.json (paused_arms, cuts, retries, first-attempt spend); a plan run_id
   206	#   with a row of this batch is done; a trial without a row reruns into a fresh -r<k> run
   207	#   dir (the stale dir is kept); counters and spend are recomputed from the rows.
   208	#   --max-usd and --concurrency may change on resume; --clear-arm, --clear-drift and
   209	#   --rerow need --resume (order: --clear-drift, --rerow and --rerun are checked before the lock,
   210	#   then --rerow replaces rows, then the counters are recomputed with the rerun-flagged rows left
   211	#   out of the done set; the reruns are dispatched with the plan). A resume clears STATUS.json
   212	#   outage (kept under outage_history[]). A start
   213	#   (fresh or resumed) is refused while a process group recorded under <batch>/.jobs/ by an
   214	#   earlier driver (one killed with SIGKILL) is still alive.
   215	#
   216	# Exit: 0 complete (every trial rowed; none transport_error, infrastructure_error,
   217	#       interrupted or contaminated), 1 partial (cut, the outage breaker, a paused arm with trials left, an
   218	#       excluded row, or the driver was signalled), 2 usage or refused, 3 failed (drift, an
   219	#       invalid or duplicated row, no trial completed without a cut, or every arm of the
   220	#       plan paused)
   221	#
   222	# Env: LOA_ABLATION_SOURCE_TREE, LOA_ABLATION_SOURCE_REPO, LOA_ABLATION_CACHE,
   223	#   LOA_ABLATION_RETRY_WAIT_S, LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_S, LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_GRACE_S,
   224	#   LOA_ABLATION_POLL_S (reap poll, default 1), LOA_ABLATION_OUTAGE_BREAKER (default 3),
   225	#   EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN (host CLI).
   226	# Library: lib/arms-common.sh beside this script, sourced by a literal relative path.
   227	# Tested by evals/tests/run-ablation.bats (stub pipeline, grader and docker; no model call).
   228	# =============================================================================

   328	for r in ${REROW_IDS[@]+"${REROW_IDS[@]}"}; do [[ "$r" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,200}$ ]] || die "invalid --rerow '$r'"; done
   329	[[ "$(printf '%s\n' ${REROW_IDS[@]+"${REROW_IDS[@]}"} | sort | uniq -d)" == "" ]] || die "--rerow lists a run_id twice"
   330	if [[ ${#RERUN_IDS[@]} -gt 0 && "$RESUME" != true ]]; then die "--rerun needs --resume"; fi
   331	if [[ ${#RERUN_STATUSES[@]} -gt 0 && "$RESUME" != true ]]; then die "--rerun-status needs --resume"; fi
   332	for s in ${RERUN_STATUSES[@]+"${RERUN_STATUSES[@]}"}; do
   333	  case "$s" in transport_error|interrupted|infrastructure_error) ;;
   334	    *) die "--rerun-status must be transport_error, interrupted or infrastructure_error (got '$s')" ;; esac
   335	done
   336	for r in ${RERUN_IDS[@]+"${RERUN_IDS[@]}"}; do
   337	  [[ "$r" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,200}$ ]] || die "invalid --rerun '$r'"
   338	  for q in ${REROW_IDS[@]+"${REROW_IDS[@]}"}; do [[ "$q" != "$r" ]] || die "--rerun $r is also a --rerow (a run is rowed again or launched again, not both)"; done
   339	done
   340	[[ "$(printf '%s\n' ${RERUN_IDS[@]+"${RERUN_IDS[@]}"} | sort | uniq -d)" == "" ]] || die "--rerun lists a run_id twice"
   341	[[ "$OUTAGE_BREAKER" =~ ^[0-9]{1,4}$ ]] || die "LOA_ABLATION_OUTAGE_BREAKER must be a whole number (0 disables)"
   342	[[ "$RESUME" != true || "$DRY_RUN" != true ]] || die "--resume and --dry-run are exclusive"
   343	[[ "$RESUME" == true || -n "$SOURCE_COMMIT" ]] || die "--source-commit is required"
   344	
   345	if [[ -z "$BATCH" ]]; then
   346	  [[ "$RESUME" != true ]] || die "--resume needs --batch NAME"
   347	  if [[ "$SMOKE" == true ]]; then BATCH="smoke-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"; else BATCH="batch-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"; fi
   348	fi
   349	[[ "$BATCH" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,80}$ ]] || die "invalid --batch '$BATCH'"
   350	case "$BATCH" in .|..) die "invalid --batch '$BATCH' (a batch is one child directory)" ;; esac

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# run-ablation.sh — the cycle-130 ablation batch runner (SDD §5.9, §3.4; sprint Task 3.2;
     4	# DEC-0405, DEC-0407, DEC-0413, DEC-0417, DEC-0418, DEC-0428, DEC-0429, DEC-0435, DEC-0545,
     5	# DEC-0553, DEC-0554)
     6	#
     7	# Plans a batch (arm × applicable task × trial), dispatches every trial to
     8	# pipeline-run.sh against a pinned source tree, checks after each trial that the arm
     9	# took effect and that the CLI version and model ids did not drift, grades the run,
    10	# writes its runs.jsonl row, and keeps MANIFEST.json and STATUS.json for the batch.
    11	#
    12	# Usage:
    13	#   run-ablation.sh --arms CSV --source-commit SHA [--tasks CSV] [--types CSV]
    14	#                   [--trials-build N] [--trials-review N] [--max-usd USD] [--run-cap USD]
    15	#                   [--concurrency 3] [--batch NAME] [--results-root DIR] [--rows F]
    16	#                   [--suite-root DIR] [--suite-file F] [--image IMG] [--executor container|host]
    17	#                   [--pre-registration-ref TEXT] [--seed N] [--self-check-log F]
    18	#                   [--smoke] [--dry-run] [--resume] [--detach] [--clear-arm ID]...
    19	#                   [--clear-drift] [--rerow RUN_ID]... [--rerun RUN_ID]... [--rerun-status S]...
    20	#                   [--pipeline-bin P] [--grade-bin G] [--row-bin R] [--took-effect-bin T]
    21	#                   [--docker-bin D]
    22	#
    23	# Options:
    24	#   --arms CSV           arm ids in the order given (default: the suite's priority minus
    25	#                        every arm declared absent: true); each must be declared
    26	#   --source-commit SHA  the Loa commit the arms run (the pinned source tree)
    27	#   --tasks CSV          task ids (default: every <suite-root>/tasks/<id>/task.yaml;
    28	#                        --smoke: every smoke/<id>/)
    29	#   --types CSV          keep tasks of these types (feature-build, bug-fix, refactor,
    30	#                        review-catch; `build` = the three build types)
    31	#   --trials-build N     trials per build task (default the suite's trials.build; --smoke 1)
    32	#   --trials-review N    trials per review-catch task (default trials.review-catch; --smoke 1)

    40	#   --results-root DIR   where batch directories live (default
    41	#                        grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/batches; --smoke

    44	#                        grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl, the tracked file, or
    45	#                        <results-root>/runs.jsonl when --results-root is given). A smoke
    46	#                        batch never writes the tracked file (DEC-0428: smoke rows decide nothing)
    47	#   --suite-root DIR     suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0)
    48	#   --suite-file F       suite file (default evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml)
    49	#   --image IMG          container image (default loa-ablation:258)
    50	#   --executor MODE      container (default) or host; passed to pipeline-run.sh and the grader
    51	#                        (host grading needs LOA_EVAL_ALLOW_HOST_GRADING=1, see ablation-grade.sh)
    52	#   --pre-registration-ref TEXT  the NOTES pre-registration heading and timestamp (MANIFEST)
    53	#   --seed N             shuffle seed (default 20261015)
    54	#   --self-check-log F   the recorded image self-check (default
    55	#                        grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-259/self-check-image.log)
    56	#   --smoke              smoke batch: smoke/ tasks, one trial each, no hard gate, own rows
    57	#   --dry-run            run the pre-flight, print the plan, write MANIFEST.json only
    58	#                        (MANIFEST.dry-run.json when the batch already has a STATUS.json)
    59	#   --resume             continue --batch NAME from its MANIFEST.json, STATUS.json and rows
    60	#   --detach             re-exec under setsid nohup (log <batch>/driver.log), print the batch
    61	#                        directory and the pid, exit 0
    62	#   --clear-arm ID       with --resume: remove ID from STATUS.json paused_arms (repeatable)
    63	#   --clear-drift        with --resume: re-read the run named by STATUS.json drift (its run dir
    64	#                        <batch>/<arm>/<task>-t<n>, or the highest -r<k> sibling) with the
    65	#                        current drift guard; none → drift null, an entry in drift_cleared[] and
    66	#                        the batch continues; still a drift → exit 2 printing it, nothing written
    67	#   --rerow RUN_ID       with --resume: run the post-run chain (took-effect, drift guard, grade,
    68	#                        ablation-row.sh with the old row's attempts and retry_reason) again
    69	#                        over the run dir of RUN_ID and replace its one row in place, under the
    70	#                        rows file's flock (temp file beside it, --validate, mv); repeatable;
    71	#                        before reconciliation, so spend and per_arm count the new row once.
    72	#                        Refused (exit 2, nothing written) when RUN_ID is not <batch>-… or not
    73	#                        in the plan, has no row or more than one, has no run dir, or its row
    74	#                        is interrupted or transport_error (those trials are reruns)
    75	#   --rerun RUN_ID       with --resume (DEC-0553): launch RUN_ID again, at its plan index, into a
    76	#                        fresh -r<k> run dir; when its new row lands it replaces the old row in
    77	#                        place (replace_row, under the flock) and STATUS.json rerun[] gets
    78	#                        {run_id, from, to, old_cost_usd, at}. The row must be transport_error,
    79	#                        interrupted or infrastructure_error, else exit 2 with nothing written
    80	#                        (also: not <batch>-…, not in the plan, no row or more than one, or the
    81	#                        same id also given to --rerow); repeatable
    82	#   --rerun-status S     with --resume: rerun every row of the batch whose status is S, one of
    83	#                        transport_error, interrupted, infrastructure_error (anything else is a
    84	#                        usage error); read after the rerows, and a --rerow id is never rerun;
    85	#                        repeatable. A flagged row leaves the done set: no counter and no
    86	#                        assumed charge, only its reported cost stays in spent (it moves to
    87	#                        ledger_usd when the replacement lands); the in-flight reservation
    88	#                        covers the new trial and its row is accounted once when it lands
    89	#   --pipeline-bin P, --grade-bin G, --row-bin R, --took-effect-bin T, --docker-bin D
    90	#                        the five collaborators (defaults: the scripts beside this one, and
    91	#                        $EVAL_DOCKER_BIN else docker)
    92	#
    93	# Pre-flight (any refusal: exit 2, nothing written but <batch>/REFUSED.txt with the reason):
    94	#   1. hard gate, non-smoke batches only (DEC-0435): <suite-root>/MANIFEST.sha256 present,
    95	#      the self-check log present with at least 2 × tasks + review-catch tasks lines
    96	#      `…: PASS` (36 for the sixteen-task suite) and no `: FAIL` line, a REVIEW.md in every
    97	#      <suite-root>/tasks/<id>/; their sha256 go to MANIFEST.json gate
    98	#   2. freeze.sh --check --root <suite-root> --suite-file <suite-file> (it runs
    99	#      validate-suite.sh), with --smoke when MANIFEST.sha256 lists a smoke/ path or the batch
   100	#      is a smoke batch (the manifest is checked as it was frozen)
   101	#   3. seed-corpus-from-record.sh --check (the review-catch corpus SHA256SUMS)
   102	#   4. container: the docker CLI and the image (`docker image inspect`)
   103	#   5. the pinned source tree: $LOA_ABLATION_SOURCE_TREE when set (tests; must be a git tree
   104	#      at the commit, with .claude/), else a detached worktree
   105	#      $LOA_ABLATION_CACHE/ablation-src-<sha12> (default ~/.cache/loa) cut from
   106	#      $LOA_ABLATION_SOURCE_REPO (default this repository) with git worktree add --detach;
   107	#      it must be at the commit and pristine (git status --porcelain --ignored empty)
   108	#   --resume also refuses when the source commit, the suite manifest hash, the image digest
   109	#   or the CLI version differ from MANIFEST.json, or when STATUS.json records a drift
   110	#   (unless --clear-drift re-reads that run clean under the current rule).
   111	#
   112	# Plan: arms × tasks × trials. An arm whose task_types excludes a task's type is dropped for
   113	# that task with one `refused:` line and never dispatched (DEC-0405). The order is
   114	# trial-major (every arm × task once before any second trial); inside each trial block the
   115	# entries (arm-major, tasks by id) are shuffled with one python3 random.Random(<seed>)
   116	# generator, blocks in trial order (Fisher-Yates via random.shuffle: reproducible for a seed
   117	# across CPython 3.x). run_id = <batch>-<arm>-<task>-t<n>; run dir <batch>/<arm>/<task>-t<n>,
   118	# a fresh <…>-r<k> (k ≥ 2) for a transport retry or a resumed rerun (the run_id stays).
   119	# --dry-run prints `plan: …`, the `refused:` lines and one line per trial
   120	# `<arm> <task> <type> <trial> <run_id>`.
   121	#
   122	# Per trial, in order: pipeline-run.sh --task-yaml … --arm … --run-dir … --run-id … --trial …
   123	#   --source-tree <pinned> --suite-file … --executor … --image … --docker-bin …
   124	#   --max-run-usd <run-cap>, output to <batch>/<arm>/<task>-t<n>.log; then
   125	#   1. status from meta/pipeline.json (missing or `running` → interrupted; a missing record
   126	#      is written as a minimal pipeline.json with synthesized_by: run-ablation.sh)
   127	#   2. transport: agent_error plus a provider signature in the failing phase's
   128	#      stderr-<label>.log or events-<label>.jsonl (lib/arms-common.sh
   129	#      is_pipeline_transport_failure) is retried ONCE after $LOA_ABLATION_RETRY_WAIT_S
   130	#      (default 120) into a fresh run dir: attempts 2, retry_reason; the first attempt writes
   131	#      no row and its spent_usd counts in spend; a second transport failure is rowed
   132	#      transport_error. agent_error without the signature is never retried (DEC-0417)
   133	#   3. took-effect.sh --run-dir D --suite-file F (completed, agent_error and cap_failure runs):
   134	#      a FAIL rows the trial infrastructure_error and pauses the arm (STATUS.json
   135	#      paused_arms; no further trial of it launches until --resume --clear-arm ID) (DEC-0418)
   136	#   4. drift guard (DEC-0407 as amended by DEC-0545): a phase drifts on model grounds only
   137	#      when its model_requested differs from MANIFEST phase_models[name], or when the
   138	#      requested model (else the manifest's) is absent from a non-empty models_used (ids
   139	#      normalised as ablation-row.sh does: no Bedrock region prefix, no -vN:M suffix). Any
   140	#      other models_used key is an extra model, telemetry and not drift (Claude Code's
   141	#      WebFetch summariser or a built-in subagent): one `run-ablation: extra model <id> in
   142	#      <labels> (<N> output tokens; …)` line in the trial log, the trial result's
   143	#      extra_models and STATUS.json extra_models. The transcripts' system/init
   144	#      claude_code_version (or version) equals MANIFEST cli_version (when neither carries a
   145	#      version, pipeline.json image_digest must equal MANIFEST image_digest). A mismatch rows
   146	#      the trial infrastructure_error, records STATUS.json drift, launches nothing more and
   147	#      fails the batch once the running trials end
   148	#   5. ablation-grade.sh D <task> --suite-root … [--tasks-dir smoke] --executor … --image …
   149	#      --docker-bin … (scored runs that passed 3 and 4; exit 2 → row infrastructure_error)
   150	#   6. ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F --manifest <batch>/MANIFEST.json
   151	#      --attempts N [--retry-reason R] [--status S] --out <job row>; the runner appends the
   152	#      row to the rows file under flock and runs ablation-row.sh --validate on it
   153	#      (--allow-ungraded for smoke) and refuses a run_id rowed twice (state failed)
   154	#   Watchdog (DEC-0429): a trial whose pipeline has no final meta/pipeline.json status after
   155	#   twice its phase-sum timeout (the planned phases' timeout_min: task bounds, else the
   156	#   suite's phase_defaults, BARE = PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 × FIX) gets SIGTERM to its process
   157	#   group, SIGKILL after $LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_GRACE_S (default 60), and is rowed
   158	#   interrupted. $LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_S replaces the deadline (seconds; tests).
   159	#   Outage breaker (DEC-0554): $LOA_ABLATION_OUTAGE_BREAKER (default 3; 0 disables) consecutive
   160	#   collected trials rowed transport_error (collection order, any arm; any other collected
   161	#   trial resets the count) stop further launches; the running trials end, STATUS.json outage
   162	#   is set and the batch finishes partial (exit 1): `partial (outage breaker): N consecutive
   163	#   transport failures; --resume --rerun-status transport_error after the network is back`.
   164	#
   165	# Spend (--max-usd, SDD §5.5 reused through lib/arms-common.sh): before each launch,
   166	#   spent + in_flight × run_cap + est_next > max waits for a running trial and
   167	#   spent + est_next > max cuts (no further launches; STATUS.json cuts[] gets {reason,
   168	#   spent, in_flight_reserved, max, est_next, trials_launched, at_trial}; exit 1).
   169	#   est_next = the mean cost of this arm's completed trials of the task kind (build |
   170	#   review-catch), else the kind's pooled mean, else the suite's cost_hint[kind]. spent =
   171	#   rows' cost_usd + transport first attempts' spent_usd + assumed charges: a trial ending
   172	#   neither completed nor with a reported cost is charged run_cap, a cap_failure is charged
   173	#   max(cost, run_cap); both count in spend.assumed_cap_trials when the charge exceeds the
   174	#   reported cost.
   175	#
   176	# Files: <results-root>/<batch>/{MANIFEST.json, STATUS.json, run.log, spend.txt,
   177	#   REFUSED.txt, driver.log, .gitignore (non-smoke: the run directories and logs stay out of
   178	#   git), <arm>/<task>-t<n>[-r<k>]/ (pipeline-run.sh run dirs), <arm>/<task>-t<n>.log};
   179	#   rows to the rows file. MANIFEST.json (§3.4): schema_version, suite, batch, dry_run,
   180	#   smoke, created, source_commit, source_worktree, source_commit_dot_claude_delta (git diff
   181	#   --stat 4d69c3c4..<commit> -- .claude/, ≤ 4,000 chars), harness_commit, harness_dirty,
   182	#   suite_file, suite_root, tasks_dir, rows_file, suite_version, suite_manifest_sha256, arms,
   183	#   tasks, refused, trials_per_type, trials_planned, plan, arm_map, shuffle_seed, shuffle,
   184	#   fingerprint, image, image_digest, executor_mode, cli_version (`docker run --rm --network
   185	#   none <image> claude --version`, host: the CLI's), cli_version_raw, tools, phase_models,
   186	#   caps {cycle_usd, run_usd, reserve_usd, max_usd}, cost_hint, concurrency, retry,
   187	#   watchdog, pre_registration_ref, gate (null for smoke), corpus, agy_opt_in, environment.
   188	#   STATUS.json (§3.4), rewritten after every trial: {schema_version, suite, batch, smoke,
   189	#   state: running|complete|partial|failed, per_arm: {<arm>: {trials_planned, launched,
   190	#   completed, failed (agent_error), excluded (transport_error, infrastructure_error,
   191	#   interrupted, contaminated), cap_failures, degraded, skipped_paused}}, retries: [{run_id,
   192	#   reason, first_attempt_usd}], cuts: [...], paused_arms: {<arm>: reason}, spend: {rows_usd,
   193	#   ledger_usd (transport first attempts, and the reported cost of rows a rerun replaced), spent_usd, max_usd, assumed_cap_trials}, resume_cursor (the
   194	#   index of the first plan entry without a row), drift: null | {run_id, field, expected,
   195	#   got}, drift_cleared: [{run_id, previous, cleared_at, harness_commit}] (--clear-drift),
   196	#   rerowed: [{run_id, from, to, at}] (--rerow), rerun: [{run_id, from, to, old_cost_usd, at}]
   197	#   (--rerun, --rerun-status), rerun_pending: [run_id…] (flagged, no replacement yet), outage:
   198	#   null | {at, consecutive, last_run_id, message} (the breaker), outage_history: [the
   199	#   outages a later --resume cleared], extra_models: {<raw id>: {runs,
   200	#   output_tokens}} ({} when none; derived from extra_models_by_run: {<run_id>: {<raw id>:
   201	#   output_tokens}}, the per-run source a rerow replaces), rows_invalid, started,
   202	#   finished}. At the end the spend.sh line and a batch line go to <batch>/spend.txt.
   203	#
   204	# --resume: reads MANIFEST.json (plan, arms, suite paths, executor, image, run cap, rows
   205	#   file) and STATUS.json (paused_arms, cuts, retries, first-attempt spend); a plan run_id
   206	#   with a row of this batch is done; a trial without a row reruns into a fresh -r<k> run
   207	#   dir (the stale dir is kept); counters and spend are recomputed from the rows.
   208	#   --max-usd and --concurrency may change on resume; --clear-arm, --clear-drift and
   209	#   --rerow need --resume (order: --clear-drift, --rerow and --rerun are checked before the lock,
   210	#   then --rerow replaces rows, then the counters are recomputed with the rerun-flagged rows left
   211	#   out of the done set; the reruns are dispatched with the plan). A resume clears STATUS.json
   212	#   outage (kept under outage_history[]). A start
   213	#   (fresh or resumed) is refused while a process group recorded under <batch>/.jobs/ by an
   214	#   earlier driver (one killed with SIGKILL) is still alive.
   215	#
   216	# Exit: 0 complete (every trial rowed; none transport_error, infrastructure_error,
   217	#       interrupted or contaminated), 1 partial (cut, the outage breaker, a paused arm with trials left, an
   218	#       excluded row, or the driver was signalled), 2 usage or refused, 3 failed (drift, an
   219	#       invalid or duplicated row, no trial completed without a cut, or every arm of the
   220	#       plan paused)
   221	#
   222	# Env: LOA_ABLATION_SOURCE_TREE, LOA_ABLATION_SOURCE_REPO, LOA_ABLATION_CACHE,
   223	#   LOA_ABLATION_RETRY_WAIT_S, LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_S, LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_GRACE_S,
   224	#   LOA_ABLATION_POLL_S (reap poll, default 1), LOA_ABLATION_OUTAGE_BREAKER (default 3),
   225	#   EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN (host CLI).
   226	# Library: lib/arms-common.sh beside this script, sourced by a literal relative path.
   227	# Tested by evals/tests/run-ablation.bats (stub pipeline, grader and docker; no model call).
   228	# =============================================================================

   230	export LC_ALL=C
   231

   238	popd >/dev/null

   241	CACHE_ROOT="${LOA_ABLATION_CACHE:-$HOME/.cache/loa}"

   254	ROW_BIN="$SCRIPT_DIR/ablation-row.sh" TOOK_BIN="$SCRIPT_DIR/took-effect.sh"

   763	# --- --clear-drift and --rerow: checked read-only before the lock (a refusal writes nothing) --
   764	run_dir_of() {  # run_dir_of <run_id> → <batch>/<arm>/<task>-t<n> or its highest -r<k> sibling; empty when none
   765	  local rel base best k max=1 d
   766	  rel="$(jq -r --arg r "$1" '[.[] | select(.run_id == $r) | .run_dir][0] // ""' "$WORK/plan-only.json")"
   767	  [[ -n "$rel" ]] || return 0
   768	  base="$BATCH_DIR/$rel" best=""
   769	  [[ -d "$base" ]] && best="$base"
   770	  for d in "$base"-r*; do
   771	    [[ -d "$d" ]] || continue
   772	    k="${d##*-r}"; [[ "$k" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || continue
   773	    if [[ $k -gt $max ]]; then max=$k best="$d"; fi
   774	  done
   775	  printf '%s' "$best"
   776	}

   874	# account_row <arm> <kind> <run_id> <status> <cost> <degraded> — counters and spend for one row
   875	account_row() {
   876	  local arm="$1" kind="$2" rid="$3" st="$4" cost="$5" deg="$6" i
   877	  i="$(arm_index "$arm")"
   878	  [[ "$cost" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$ ]] || cost=0
   879	  case "$st" in
   880	    completed) C_COMPLETED[$i]=$(( ${C_COMPLETED[$i]} + 1 )) ;;
   881	    cap_failure) C_CAP[$i]=$(( ${C_CAP[$i]} + 1 )) ;;
   882	    agent_error) C_FAILED[$i]=$(( ${C_FAILED[$i]} + 1 )) ;;
   883	    *) C_EXCLUDED[$i]=$(( ${C_EXCLUDED[$i]} + 1 )) ;;
   884	  esac
   885	  [[ "$deg" == true ]] && C_DEGRADED[$i]=$(( ${C_DEGRADED[$i]} + 1 ))
   886	  ROWS_USD="$(fadd "$ROWS_USD" "$cost")"
   887	  if [[ "$st" == cap_failure ]]; then
   888	    if awk -v c="$cost" -v r="$RUN_CAP" 'BEGIN { exit !(c < r) }'; then
   889	      SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$RUN_CAP")"; ASSUMED_CAP=$((ASSUMED_CAP + 1))
   890	      log "assumed cap: $rid ended cap_failure at USD $cost; USD $RUN_CAP charged to spent"
   891	    else
   892	      SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$cost")"
   893	    fi
   894	  else
   895	    spend_charge "$st" "$cost" "$rid"
   896	    if [[ "$st" == completed ]]; then est_record "$arm|$kind" "$kind" "$CHARGED_COST"; fi
   897	  fi
   898	}

   963	# post_run <run-dir> <run_id> <task> <task_yaml> <attempts> <retry_reason> <pipeline_status>
   964	#          <override> <row-out> <log> — the chain after a finished pipeline, shared by a trial
   965	# and by --rerow: took-effect, drift guard, grade (completed, agent_error and cap_failure runs
   966	# without an override), then ablation-row.sh into <row-out>. Results in PR_TE (ok | fail |
   967	# skipped), PR_TE_REASON, PR_DRIFT (json or null), PR_EXTRA (the extra models, json),

   969	post_run() {

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# lib/arms-common.sh — helpers shared by the two batch runners (cycle-130 Task 3.2)
     4	#
     5	# Sourced (never executed) by evals/harness/run-arms.sh (cycle-129 recall arms) and
     6	# evals/harness/run-ablation.sh (cycle-130 ablation batches), each by the literal
     7	# relative path ./lib/arms-common.sh after `pushd "$SCRIPT_DIR"` (eval.yml trust
     8	# boundary: no variable on a source line, no .claude/ code). Extracted from
     9	# run-arms.sh without behaviour change; evals/tests/run-arms.bats is the golden check.
    10	#
    11	# Functions:
    12	#   usd_ok <v>                 0 when <v> is an amount in USD (1-6 digits, up to 4 decimals)
    13	#   fadd <a> <b>               a + b, printed %.10g (awk)
    14	#   json_array <v>…            the arguments as a compact JSON string array
    15	#   is_transport_failure <ws>  run-arms layout: <ws>/.eval/{executor.json,agent-output.json,
    16	#                              agent-stderr.log}; 0 when the executor failed for a transport
    17	#                              reason (timeout exit 124/137/143, no result event, API error
    18	#                              status, or a CLI transport message on stderr)
    19	#   is_pipeline_transport_failure <run-dir>
    20	#                              pipeline-run.sh layout: 0 when meta/pipeline.json says
    21	#                              agent_error AND the failing phase (the last executed record
    22	#                              with a non-zero exit, else the last executed record) shows a
    23	#                              provider/transport signature: its transcripts/stderr-<label>.log
    24	#                              matches ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE, or its events-<label>.jsonl holds a
    25	#                              result event with a non-empty api_error_status, or an is_error
    26	#                              result (the CLI's own error, never the agent's text) whose text
    27	#                              starts "API Error" or matches ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE (a usage or
    28	#                              session limit). Assistant messages are never read. A phase timeout is the
    29	#                              model's own account (DEC-0417) and is never transport here.
    30	#                              Prints the signature source (stderr | api_error_status |
    31	#                              api_error_result) and the phase label on success.
    32	#   est_record <key> <pool> <cost>   add one completed trial's cost to the key's and the
    33	#                              pool's means (est_next's inputs)
    34	#   est_next <key> [<pool>]    the next trial's expected cost: the key's mean, else the
    35	#                              pool's mean (default pool "all"), else `est_hint <key>`
    36	#                              (default: $COST_HINT; a runner may redefine est_hint)
    37	#   spend_charge <status> <cost> <what>
    38	#                              charge one finished trial to SPENT: a trial that ended
    39	#                              without status completed and without a reported cost is
    40	#                              charged RUN_CAP (ASSUMED_CAP+1, logged); else its cost.
    41	#                              Sets CHARGED_COST to the reported cost it accepted (0 for an
    42	#                              assumed charge); call it directly, never in $( ), or SPENT
    43	#                              is lost with the subshell
    44	#   budget_gate <key> <trial-number> [<pool>]

    51	# =============================================================================
    52	
    53	usd_ok() { [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]{1,6}(\.[0-9]{1,4})?$ ]]; }

    56	
    57	# The CLI's transport messages (audit r1 DISS-C-005: matched on the CLI's stderr only,
    58	# never on the agent's own output, so the agent under test cannot earn itself a retry
    59	# by mentioning a network error).
    60	ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE='rate.?limit|overloaded|session limit|usage limit|out of extra usage|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|socket hang up|^(fetch|request) failed|HTTP 5[0-9][0-9]'
    61	
    62	is_transport_failure() {  # is_transport_failure <sandbox-ws>

    72	is_pipeline_transport_failure() {  # is_pipeline_transport_failure <run-dir>

    86	                      elif .is_error == true and ((.result // "") | type) == "string"
    87	                           and ((.result // "") | test("^API Error|" + $re; "i")) then "api_error_result"

    93	
    94	# --- est_next inputs (completed trials only; assumed charges never enter) ---------
    95	EST_KEYS=() EST_SUM=() EST_N=() POOL_KEYS=() POOL_SUM=() POOL_N=()
    96	_est_find() {  # _est_find <EST|POOL> <key> → index or -1
    97	  local i

    99	    for i in ${EST_KEYS[@]+"${!EST_KEYS[@]}"}; do [[ "${EST_KEYS[$i]}" == "$2" ]] && { echo "$i"; return; }; done

   102	  fi
   103	  echo -1
   104	}

     4	#

    10	#

     8	# applies the pre-registered rules to every component arm (A2 … A7) against the

    10	# writes report.md (and a --json twin with the same numbers).
    11	#
    12	# Usage:
    13	#   ablation-report.py --runs F [--runs F ...] --manifests DIR [--manifests DIR ...]
    14	#                      --suite F --out report.md [--json report.json]

    22	#                       a row with another major, no schema_version, or a line that is not
    23	#                       a JSON object stops the report (exit 2, naming file:line and run_id).
    24	#                       A run_id seen twice keeps its last row (the earlier one is listed).
    25	#   --manifests DIR     a directory searched recursively (symlinks not followed) for
    26	#                       MANIFEST.json files (repeatable). Each gives a batch's provenance:

    29	#                       executor.cli_version), image_digest, smoke. A manifest with an
    30	#                       unknown schema_version major, two manifests claiming one batch, or
    31	#                       an arm_map entry disagreeing with a row's arm → exit 2.
    32	#   --suite F           the suite file: YAML read through `yq -o=json` (mikefarah yq v4,
    33	#                       as arms-report.py does), or JSON when the file parses as JSON.
    34	#                       The Method section quotes its `rules:` block verbatim.
    35	#   --out F             report.md (the only files written are --out and --json; a symlink
    36	#                       at either path is refused)
    37	#   --json F            the JSON twin (schema_version 1)
    38	#   --seed N            bootstrap seed (default 20261015); every interval uses its own
    39	#                       random.Random(seed), so a figure does not depend on which other

    47	#                       comparison (A2–A7, H1, A4) has a valid pair on every primary it uses
    48	#   --cuts F            a JSON list of {arm, reason, figure[, state]} the lead recorded;
    49	#                       arm is an id (a5_no_flatline) or a label (A5); state is not_run_cut

    52	#
    53	# Row treatment (DEC-0393, DEC-0417):
    54	#   not decided, listed  rows of a smoke batch (manifest smoke: true), rows whose batch has
    55	#                        no manifest, rows of an arm the suite does not run (absent or
    56	#                        unknown), rows on a task type outside the arm's task_types
    57	#                        (applicability refusals; not counted in the excluded share)
    58	#   excluded pairwise    status in rules.exclusion.statuses plus transport_error and
    59	#                        infrastructure_error (DEC-0417), degraded: true (with

    61	#                        null (ungraded); the task-trial cell leaves BOTH arms of every

    65	#   The sensitivity figure repeats the comparison with cap_failure excluded pairwise
    66	#   instead of scored 0; no decision reads it.
    67	#
    68	# Statistics (pre-registered in the suite's rules block; formulas in the Method section):
    69	#   pass rate unit  the task: per task, the mean over its valid trials, arm minus a1_full
    70	#   catch-rate unit the defect: per review-catch task and defect dK, the share of the
    71	#                   arm's valid trials that caught it, arm minus a1_full; per-defect ids

    78	#                   statistics, [lo, hi] = the (1-level)/2 and 1-(1-level)/2 quantiles

   180	def percentile(sorted_xs, q):
   181	    """Linear interpolation between order statistics (numpy's default 'linear')."""
   182	    n = len(sorted_xs)
   183	    if n == 0:
   184	        return None
   185	    pos = q * (n - 1)
   186	    lo = int(math.floor(pos))
   187	    hi = min(lo + 1, n - 1)
   188	    frac = pos - lo
   189	    return sorted_xs[lo] + (sorted_xs[hi] - sorted_xs[lo]) * frac

   192	def bootstrap(diffs, resamples, level, seed):
   193	    if not diffs:
   194	        return None, None
   195	    rng = random.Random(seed)
   196	    n = len(diffs)
   197	    means = sorted(sum(rng.choices(diffs, k=n)) / n for _ in range(resamples))
   198	    a = (1.0 - level) / 2.0
   199	    return percentile(means, a), percentile(means, 1.0 - a)

   202	def mde(diffs, level):
   203	    if len(diffs) < 2:
   204	        return None
   205	    nd = statistics.NormalDist()
   206	    z = nd.inv_cdf(1.0 - (1.0 - level) / 2.0) + nd.inv_cdf(POWER)
   207	    return z * statistics.stdev(diffs) / math.sqrt(len(diffs))

   210	def collapse(run_ids):
   211	    """batch-arm-task-t1, -t2, -t3 → batch-arm-task-t1…t3 (non-contiguous: t1,t3)."""
   212	    groups, other = {}, []
   213	    for rid in run_ids:
   214	        m = re.fullmatch(r"(.*-t)(\d+)", rid)
   215	        if m:
   216	            groups.setdefault(m.group(1), []).append(int(m.group(2)))
   217	        else:
   218	            other.append(rid)
   219	    out = []
   220	    for prefix in sorted(groups):
   221	        ns = sorted(set(groups[prefix]))
   222	        if len(ns) == 1:
   223	            out.append(f"{prefix}{ns[0]}")
   224	        elif len(ns) >= 3 and ns == list(range(ns[0], ns[-1] + 1)):
   225	            out.append(f"{prefix}{ns[0]}…t{ns[-1]}")
   226	        else:
   227	            out.append(prefix + ",t".join(str(n) for n in ns))
   228	    return out + sorted(other)

    55	#                        no manifest, rows of an arm the suite does not run (absent or
    56	#                        unknown), rows on a task type outside the arm's task_types
    57	#                        (applicability refusals; not counted in the excluded share)

   180	def percentile(sorted_xs, q):
   181	    """Linear interpolation between order statistics (numpy's default 'linear')."""
   182	    n = len(sorted_xs)
   183	    if n == 0:
   184	        return None
   185	    pos = q * (n - 1)
   186	    lo = int(math.floor(pos))
   187	    hi = min(lo + 1, n - 1)
   188	    frac = pos - lo
   189	    return sorted_xs[lo] + (sorted_xs[hi] - sorted_xs[lo]) * frac

   192	def bootstrap(diffs, resamples, level, seed):
   193	    if not diffs:
   194	        return None, None
   195	    rng = random.Random(seed)
   196	    n = len(diffs)
   197	    means = sorted(sum(rng.choices(diffs, k=n)) / n for _ in range(resamples))
   198	    a = (1.0 - level) / 2.0
   199	    return percentile(means, a), percentile(means, 1.0 - a)
   200

   202	def mde(diffs, level):
   203	    if len(diffs) < 2:
   204	        return None
   205	    nd = statistics.NormalDist()
   206	    z = nd.inv_cdf(1.0 - (1.0 - level) / 2.0) + nd.inv_cdf(POWER)
   207	    return z * statistics.stdev(diffs) / math.sqrt(len(diffs))

   210	def collapse(run_ids):
   211	    """batch-arm-task-t1, -t2, -t3 → batch-arm-task-t1…t3 (non-contiguous: t1,t3)."""
   212	    groups, other = {}, []
   213	    for rid in run_ids:
   214	        m = re.fullmatch(r"(.*-t)(\d+)", rid)
   215	        if m:
   216	            groups.setdefault(m.group(1), []).append(int(m.group(2)))
   217	        else:
   218	            other.append(rid)
   219	    out = []
   220	    for prefix in sorted(groups):
   221	        ns = sorted(set(groups[prefix]))
   222	        if len(ns) == 1:
   223	            out.append(f"{prefix}{ns[0]}")
   224	        elif len(ns) >= 3 and ns == list(range(ns[0], ns[-1] + 1)):
   225	            out.append(f"{prefix}{ns[0]}…t{ns[-1]}")
   226	        else:
   227	            out.append(prefix + ",t".join(str(n) for n in ns))
   228	    return out + sorted(other)

   494	    def compare(self, arm, ctrl, metric, seed):
   495	        types = (REVIEW,) if metric == CATCH else BUILD_TYPES

   497	        res = {"metric": metric, "arm": arm, "control": ctrl, "unit": "tasks", "pairs": [], "unpaired": [],
   498	               "dropped": [], "diffs": [], "task_diffs": [], "defect_identity": set()}
   499	        for task in tasks:
   500	            ca, cc = self.cells.get((arm, task), {}), self.cells.get((ctrl, task), {})
   501	            drop = sorted(t for t in set(ca) | set(cc)
   502	                          if (t in ca and ca[t]["valid"] is None) or (t in cc and cc[t]["valid"] is None))
   503	            for t in drop:
   504	                for side, cs in ((arm, ca), (ctrl, cc)):
   505	                    if t in cs and cs[t]["valid"] is not None:
   506	                        res["dropped"].append({"task_id": task, "trial": t, "arm": side,
   507	                                               "run_id": cs[t]["valid"]["run_id"]})
   508	            va = [ca[t]["valid"] for t in sorted(ca) if t not in drop]
   509	            vc = [cc[t]["valid"] for t in sorted(cc) if t not in drop]
   510	            if not va or not vc:
   511	                why = []
   512	                for side, cs, vs in ((arm, ca, va), (ctrl, cc, vc)):
   513	                    if vs:
   514	                        continue
   515	                    if not cs:
   516	                        why.append(f"no row in {side}")
   517	                    elif all(cs[t]["valid"] is None for t in cs):
   518	                        why.append(f"every cell of {side} excluded")
   519	                    else:
   520	                        why.append(f"the cells of {side} dropped pairwise")
   521	                res["unpaired"].append({"task_id": task, "reason": "; ".join(why)})
   522	                continue
   523	            pair = {"task_id": task, "arm_runs": [r["run_id"] for r in va], "control_runs": [r["run_id"] for r in vc],
   524	                    "arm_cost": mean([float(r.get("cost_usd") or 0) for r in va]),
   525	                    "control_cost": mean([float(r.get("cost_usd") or 0) for r in vc]),
   526	                    "arm_wall": mean([float(r.get("wall_clock_ms") or 0) for r in va]),
   527	                    "control_wall": mean([float(r.get("wall_clock_ms") or 0) for r in vc])}
   528	            if metric == PASS:
   529	                ma, mc = mean([self.pass_score(r) for r in va]), mean([self.pass_score(r) for r in vc])
   530	                pair.update(arm_value=ma, control_value=mc, diff=ma - mc)
   531	                res["diffs"].append(ma - mc)
   532	                res["task_diffs"].append(ma - mc)
   533	            else:
   534	                ma, mc = mean([self.catch_task_score(r) for r in va]), mean([self.catch_task_score(r) for r in vc])
   535	                pair.update(arm_value=ma, control_value=mc, diff=ma - mc)
   536	                res["task_diffs"].append(ma - mc)
   537	                vecs_a = [self.defect_vector(r) for r in va]
   538	                vecs_c = [self.defect_vector(r) for r in vc]
   539	                for _, how in vecs_a + vecs_c:
   540	                    res["defect_identity"].add(how)
   541	                if all(v is not None for v, _ in vecs_a + vecs_c):
   542	                    n = len(vecs_a[0][0])
   543	                    dd = [mean([v[k] for v, _ in vecs_a]) - mean([v[k] for v, _ in vecs_c]) for k in range(n)]
   544	                    pair["defects"] = n
   545	                    pair["defect_diffs"] = dd
   546	                    res["diffs"].extend(dd)
   547	                else:
   548	                    pair["defects"] = 0
   549	            res["pairs"].append(pair)

   551	            res["unit"] = "defects"
   552	        res["defect_identity"] = sorted(res["defect_identity"] - {"cap"})
   553	        n = len(res["diffs"])
   554	        res["n"] = n

   582	    def decide(self, arm, comps, c, w, share):
   583	        T = float(self.rules.get("threshold_points", 0.03))
   584	        C = float(self.rules.get("cost_lower_pct", 15))
   585	        P = [p for p in comps if p["n"] > 0]
   586	        nopair = len(P) < len(comps)
   587	        name = lambda p: p["metric"]  # noqa: E731
   588	        if share is not None and r9(share) > self.guard:
   589	            # DEC-0393: the degradation guard reads first, whatever the interval (lead's ruling, Sprint 260)
   590	            clause = f"excluded share {share:.3f} > {self.guard:g}"
   591	            return "inconclusive", f"inconclusive (degradation guard, evaluated first): {clause}", [clause]
   592	        hits = [name(p) for p in P if r9(p["lo"]) > 0]
   593	        if hits:
   594	            return "investigate", f"investigate: any applicable primary has lo > 0 ({', '.join(hits)})", []
   595	        hits = [name(p) for p in P if r9(p["d"]) < -T and r9(p["hi"]) < 0]
   596	        if hits:
   597	            return "keep", f"keep: any applicable primary has d < -{T:g} and hi < 0 ({', '.join(hits)})", []
   598	        clauses = []
   599	        hits = [name(p) for p in P if r9(p["d"]) < -T]
   600	        if hits:
   601	            clauses.append(f"d < -{T:g} ({', '.join(hits)})")
   602	        if nopair:
   603	            clauses.append("no valid pair (" + ", ".join(name(p) for p in comps if p["n"] == 0) + ")")
   604	        if clauses:
   605	            return "inconclusive", "inconclusive: " + "; ".join(clauses), clauses
   606	        cost_ok = (c is not None and r9(c) <= -C) or (w is not None and r9(w) <= -C)
   607	        if all(r9(p["d"]) >= -T for p in comps) and cost_ok:
   608	            which = []
   609	            if c is not None and r9(c) <= -C:
   610	                which.append(f"c = {c:+.1f}")
   611	            if w is not None and r9(w) <= -C:
   612	                which.append(f"w = {w:+.1f}")
   613	            return "remove", (f"remove: every applicable primary has d >= -{T:g} and "
   614	                              f"(c <= -{C:g} or w <= -{C:g}) ({', '.join(which)})"), []
   615	        return "simplify", f"simplify: every applicable primary within -{T:g}, cost similar", []

   617	    def arm_report(self, arm, cuts, seed):
   618	        prims = self.primaries(arm)
   619	        comps = [self.compare(arm, CONTROL, m, seed) for m in prims]
   620	        c, w, n_cost = self.deltas(comps)
   621	        share, ex, seen = self.excluded_share(arm)
   622	        out = {"arm": arm, "arm_label": self.arms[arm].get("label", arm), "primaries": prims,
   623	               "comparisons": comps, "c": c, "w": w, "cost_tasks": n_cost,
   624	               "excluded_share": share, "excluded_cells": ex, "cells_seen": seen}
   625	        if not seen:
   626	            state, rule, clauses = "no_rows", "no rows for this arm", []
   627	        else:
   628	            state, rule, clauses = self.decide(arm, comps, c, w, share)
   629	        out["predicate_state"] = state
   630	        out["predicate_rule"] = rule
   631	        label = DISPLAY.get(state, state)
   632	        if state == "inconclusive" and any(cl.startswith("excluded share") for cl in clauses):
   633	            label = "Inconclusive-by-degradation"
   634	        out["predicate_label"] = label
   635	        figure = None
   636	        mde_cut = self.rules.get("mde_cut")
   637	        over = [p for p in comps if p["mde"] is not None and mde_cut is not None and r9(p["mde"]) > float(mde_cut)]
   638	        if arm in cuts:
   639	            cut = cuts[arm]
   640	            state, label = cut["state"], DISPLAY[cut["state"]]
   641	            rule = f"{cut['source']}: {cut['reason']}".rstrip(": ")
   642	            figure = cut["figure"]
   643	        elif state in ("remove", "simplify") and over:
   644	            figure = "; ".join(f"MDE {p['mde']:.3f} > {float(mde_cut):g} on {p['metric']} (n = {p['n']} {p['unit']})"
   645	                               for p in over)
   646	            rule = f"inconclusive_by_power: {figure} (predicate read {DISPLAY[out['predicate_state']]})"
   647	            state, label = "inconclusive_by_power", DISPLAY["inconclusive_by_power"]
   648	        out.update(state=state, label=label, rule=rule, figure=figure,
   649	                   mde_flag=[p["metric"] for p in over])
   650	        out["decidable"] = bool(seen) and all(p["n"] > 0 for p in comps)
   651	        return out

1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# evals/tests/ablation-report.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 260 Task 3.8 (AC-3.10; PRD AC-8.1–8.3;
     4	# SDD §5.12; DEC-0393, DEC-0399, DEC-0400, DEC-0416, DEC-0417, DEC-0434, DEC-0435)
     5	#
     6	# ablation-report.py on planted rows: fixtures/ablation-report/gen-fixtures.py writes four
     7	# scenarios (main, boundary, exclusions, partial; the header there lists every planted
     8	# number) into the file tmpdir; setup_file builds the three full reports once against the
     9	# real suite file evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml.
    10	# =============================================================================
    11	
    12	setup_file() {
    13	  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
    14	  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    15	  export REPO_ROOT
    16	  export REPORT="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/ablation-report.py"
    17	  export SUITE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
    18	  export FX="$BATS_FILE_TMPDIR/fx"
    19	  mkdir -p "$FX"
    20	  python3 -I "$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation-report/gen-fixtures.py" "$FX"
    21	  for s in main boundary exclusions; do
    22	    python3 -I "$REPORT" --runs "$FX/$s/runs.jsonl" --manifests "$FX/$s/manifests" --suite "$SUITE" \
    23	      --out "$FX/$s/report.md" --json "$FX/$s/report.json" >/dev/null
    24	  done
    25	}
    26	
    27	setup() {
    28	  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ar.XXXXXX")"
    29	}
    30	
    31	teardown() {
    32	  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
    33	  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
    34	}
    35	
    36	dec() {  # dec <scenario> <arm> <jq path under the decision>
    37	  jq -r --arg a "$2" ".decisions[] | select(.arm == \$a) | $3" "$FX/$1/report.json"
    38	}
    39	
    40	cmp_of() {  # cmp_of <scenario> <arm> <metric> <jq path under the comparison>
    41	  jq -r --arg a "$2" --arg m "$3" ".decisions[] | select(.arm == \$a) | .comparisons[] | select(.metric == \$m) | $4" "$FX/$1/report.json"
    42	}
    43	
    44	report() {  # report <scenario> <out-prefix> [extra args]
    45	  local s="$1" o="$2"; shift 2
    46	  run python3 -I "$REPORT" --runs "$FX/$s/runs.jsonl" --manifests "$FX/$s/manifests" --suite "$SUITE" \
    47	    --out "$o.md" --json "$o.json" "$@"
    48	}
    49	
    50	@test "AR-1 each rule branch on planted rows: -0.05 tight Keep, 0.00 at -20 % cost Remove, 0.00 similar cost Simplify, wide Inconclusive, +0.04 Investigate" {
    51	  [ "$(dec main a2_no_sprint_plan .state)" = "keep" ]
    52	  [ "$(cmp_of main a2_no_sprint_plan hidden_test_pass_rate .d)" = "-0.05" ]
    53	  [ "$(cmp_of main a2_no_sprint_plan hidden_test_pass_rate '.hi < 0')" = "true" ]
    54	  [ "$(dec main a3_one_voice .state)" = "remove" ]
    55	  [ "$(dec main a3_one_voice '.c == -20')" = "true" ]
    56	  [ "$(dec main a5_no_flatline .state)" = "simplify" ]
    57	  [ "$(dec main a5_no_flatline '.c == -5')" = "true" ]
    58	  [ "$(dec main a6_one_window .state)" = "inconclusive" ]
    59	  [ "$(cmp_of main a6_one_window hidden_test_pass_rate '.lo < 0 and .hi > 0')" = "true" ]
    60	  [ "$(dec main a7_effort_medium .state)" = "investigate" ]
    61	  [ "$(cmp_of main a7_effort_medium hidden_test_pass_rate .lo)" = "0.04" ]
    62	  grep -qF '| A2 | `a2_no_sprint_plan` | 12 tasks | -0.050 [-0.052, -0.048] | n/a (build-only) |' "$FX/main/report.md"
    63	  grep -qF '**Investigate** | investigate: any applicable primary has lo > 0 (hidden_test_pass_rate)' "$FX/main/report.md"
    64	}
    65	
    66	@test "AR-2 exactly at threshold: d = -0.03 is not Keep and is Remove at c = -15 (inclusive) or Simplify; hi = 0 is not Keep (strict); w = -15 is Remove" {
    67	  [ "$(cmp_of boundary a2_no_sprint_plan hidden_test_pass_rate .d)" = "-0.03" ]
    68	  [ "$(cmp_of boundary a2_no_sprint_plan hidden_test_pass_rate .hi)" = "-0.03" ]
    69	  [ "$(dec boundary a2_no_sprint_plan '.c == -15')" = "true" ]
    70	  [ "$(dec boundary a2_no_sprint_plan .state)" = "remove" ]
    71	  [ "$(dec boundary a5_no_flatline .state)" = "simplify" ]
    72	  [ "$(cmp_of boundary a6_one_window hidden_test_pass_rate '.hi == 0')" = "true" ]
    73	  [ "$(cmp_of boundary a6_one_window hidden_test_pass_rate .d)" = "-0.04" ]
    74	  [ "$(dec boundary a6_one_window .state)" = "inconclusive" ]
    75	  [ "$(dec boundary a6_one_window .rule)" = "inconclusive: d < -0.03 (hidden_test_pass_rate)" ]
    76	  [ "$(dec boundary a3_one_voice '.w == -15')" = "true" ]
    77	  [ "$(dec boundary a3_one_voice .state)" = "remove" ]
    78	}

    80	@test "AR-3 a cap failure scores 0 on the primary, is listed, and the labelled sensitivity figure (cap failures excluded) differs" {
    81	  [ "$(jq -r '.cap_failures | join(",")' "$FX/exclusions/report.json")" = "excl-1-a2_no_sprint_plan-fb-01-t1" ]
    82	  # fb-01: trials 0 (cap, the row says 0.9), 0.40, 0.40 → 0.266667 against a1's 0.40
    83	  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a2_no_sprint_plan hidden_test_pass_rate '.pairs[] | select(.task_id == "fb-01") | .arm_value')" = "0.266667" ]
    84	  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a2_no_sprint_plan hidden_test_pass_rate .d)" = "-0.011111" ]
    85	  [ "$(jq -r '.sensitivity.rows[] | select(.arm == "a2_no_sprint_plan") | .comparisons[0].d == 0' "$FX/exclusions/report.json")" = "true" ]
    86	  [ "$(jq -r '.sensitivity.label' "$FX/exclusions/report.json")" = "sensitivity (cap failures excluded) — no decision uses this" ]
    87	  grep -qF '## Sensitivity figure: sensitivity (cap failures excluded) — no decision uses this' "$FX/exclusions/report.md"
    88	  grep -qF -- '- `excl-1-a2_no_sprint_plan-fb-01-t1` (`a2_no_sprint_plan`, fb-01 t1, cap_phase IMPLEMENT, USD 12.00)' "$FX/exclusions/report.md"
    89	}
    90	
    91	@test "AR-4 a degraded cell is dropped from both arms (pairwise); --exclude-degraded false counts it" {
    92	  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a3_one_voice hidden_test_pass_rate '.pairs[] | select(.task_id == "fb-02") | .diff == 0')" = "true" ]
    93	  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a3_one_voice hidden_test_pass_rate '.pairs[] | select(.task_id == "fb-02") | .control_runs | join(",")')" = "excl-1-a1_full-fb-02-t1,excl-1-a1_full-fb-02-t3" ]
    94	  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a3_one_voice hidden_test_pass_rate '.dropped[] | .run_id')" = "excl-1-a1_full-fb-02-t2" ]
    95	  [ "$(jq -r '.exclusions[] | select(.run_id == "excl-1-a3_one_voice-fb-02-t2") | .reason' "$FX/exclusions/report.json")" = "degraded: IMPLEMENT models_used global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5" ]
    96	  report exclusions "$T/nodeg" --exclude-degraded false
    97	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    98	  [ "$(jq -r '.decisions[] | select(.arm == "a3_one_voice") | .comparisons[0].pairs[] | select(.task_id == "fb-02") | .diff' "$T/nodeg.json")" = "-0.243333" ]
    99	}
   100	
   101	@test "AR-5 an arm with 11 of 36 cells excluded (30.6 %) reads Inconclusive-by-degradation although its valid cells read +0.05 with lo > 0 (guard first, DEC-0393); excluded rows are listed" {
   102	  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a5_no_flatline hidden_test_pass_rate .d)" = "0.05" ]
   103	  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a5_no_flatline hidden_test_pass_rate '.lo > 0')" = "true" ]
   104	  [ "$(dec exclusions a5_no_flatline .state)" = "inconclusive" ]
   105	  [ "$(dec exclusions a5_no_flatline .label)" = "Inconclusive-by-degradation" ]

   107	  [ "$(dec exclusions a5_no_flatline .rule)" = "inconclusive (degradation guard, evaluated first): excluded share 0.306 > 0.25" ]
   108	  [ "$(jq '[.exclusions[] | select(.arm == "a5_no_flatline")] | length' "$FX/exclusions/report.json")" -eq 11 ]
   109	  grep -qF '| `excl-1-a5_no_flatline-fb-01-t1` | `a5_no_flatline` | fb-01 | 1 | contaminated | contaminated |' "$FX/exclusions/report.md"
   110	  grep -qF '| `excl-1-a2_no_sprint_plan-rf-01-t3` | `a2_no_sprint_plan` | rf-01 | 3 | transport_error | transport_error |' "$FX/exclusions/report.md"

   113	@test "AR-6 build-only arms (A2, A4, A5, A6) are decided on the pass rate alone; all-type arms on both; a refused review-catch row is listed, never counted" {
   114	  for a in a2_no_sprint_plan a4_no_gates a5_no_flatline a6_one_window; do

   126	@test "AR-7 defects are the catch-rate unit: rc-01's 8 defects weigh 8 in the decision interval and 1 in also_report" {
   127	  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a7_effort_medium defect_catch_rate .unit)" = "defects" ]

   144	@test "AR-9 Not run (cut) from --cuts and --not-run, a pre-declared Inconclusive-by-power, each with its figure" {
   145	  printf '%s\n' '[{"arm":"A5","reason":"ladder rung 1","figure":"spent 1270.00 of max 1270"},' \
   146	    '{"arm":"a6_one_window","state":"inconclusive_by_power","reason":"smoke variance","figure":"MDE 0.14 > 0.10"}]' > "$T/cuts.json"
   147	  report main "$T/r" --cuts "$T/cuts.json" --not-run a7_effort_medium
   148	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
   149	  [ "$(jq -r '.decisions[] | select(.arm == "a5_no_flatline") | .state' "$T/r.json")" = "not_run_cut" ]

   151	  [ "$(jq -r '.decisions[] | select(.arm == "a7_effort_medium") | .state' "$T/r.json")" = "not_run_cut" ]
   152	  grep -qF '**Not run (cut) — spent 1270.00 of max 1270**' "$T/r.md"

   162	  [ "$(dec exclusions a6_one_window .predicate_state)" = "simplify" ]

   177	@test "AR-12 the expected-false-positive sentence and the Method section quoting the suite rules block verbatim" {

   179	  python3 -I - "$SUITE" "$FX/main/report.md" <<'PY'
   180	import re, sys

   184	block = "\n".join(suite[start:end]).rstrip()

No test covers `--types`; add one and compute the type before the select (e.g. `.type as $t | select($want == "" or (($want | split(" ")) | index($t)) != null)`).
head/evals/harness/ablation-grade.sh:1377 — grader 1.2.2 heredoc stripping removes more than the body: `[^\n]*` after the delimiter swallows the rest of the heredoc's own line, so `cat <<EOF > /home/operator/.ssh/authorized_keys` or `cat <<'EOF' | tee /root/x` collapses to `cat <<HEREDOC` and the outside write is never seen by the path scan (verified). Review written to `review.md`. Verdict: CHANGES_REQUIRED.

**What I checked.** I read the new batch runner, the shared library, the report generator, the grader and row-builder diffs, the suite change, and all test files. I ran the report bats suite on a scratch copy of `pr/head` (22/22 pass) and syntax-checked every shell script. The runner, row and grader bats suites need the frozen suite tree and fixtures that are not part of this PR, so I could not execute them. Each defect below I verified by hand with jq or Python instead.

**Blocking findings**

- **`--types` is broken** in run-ablation.sh. The jq filter evaluates `.type` against the split array, so jq errors on every task and the runner dies. No test exercises the flag.
- **Heredoc stripping hides outside writes** in the grader. The regex swallows the remainder of the heredoc's own line, so `cat <<EOF > /home/operator/.ssh/authorized_keys` collapses to `cat <<HEREDOC` and the outside path is never scanned.
- **`/.` prefix bypass** in the grader. Skipping every word that starts with `/.` also skips `/./home/...` and `/../root/...`, which the previous normalising check caught.

**Lower-severity findings**

- Any absolute path containing `=` is skipped by the new 1.2.4 rule, not just regex or key=value tokens.
- The narrowed `hidden` token rule no longer flags `ls hidden` or a `*hidden*` glob, while the header still promises "any case".
- The report treats a missing `task_types` as "applies to nothing" while the runner treats it as "all".
- The spend.txt label and the header's spend formula omit the replaced-row costs that now sit in the ledger.

**What's next.** Fix the `--types` select, strip only heredoc body lines, and tighten the `/.` and `=` skip rules with tests for the bypass shapes. The remaining items are documentation and consistency fixes.
